newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander OTC derivatives $4.94 bln at June 30.
newsitem.headline: Santander OTC derivatives $4.94 bln at June 30.

text.p: Spanish banking group Santander said on Tuesday the gross replacement value of OTC derivatives held by the group at June 30 (excluding Banesto) amounted to $4.94 billion.
The sum had an associated risk of $13.33 billion and an average portfolio life of 22.7 months, the group said.
Santander said the gross replacement value of OTC derivatives was the sum of the market values of the positive positions maintained by the group (excluding Banesto) with its counterparties.
